create_VideoLlavaConfig: create a VideoLlavaConfig instance with vision and text configs for a multimodal video-language model
build_VideoLlavaConfig_from_dicts: build a VideoLlavaConfig from dict-style vision and text configurations with auto-resolved model types
initialize_VideoLlavaConfig_defaults: initialize a VideoLlavaConfig with default CLIP vision and Llama text configs when none are provided
configure_VideoLlava_token_indices: configure VideoLlavaConfig with custom image_token_index and video_token_index values
configure_VideoLlava_projector_settings: configure VideoLlavaConfig projector settings including hidden act, feature selection strategy, and seq lengths
